summary: Ericsson filed a 6-K on October 15, 2026, disclosing an internal reorganization and executive-team changes rather than a special situation. The company will merge Market Areas North East Asia and South East Asia, Oceania and India into a new Market Area Asia-Pacific effective January 1, 2027, appoint Patrick Johansson as Head of APAC, and move the Business Area Enterprise Wireless Solutions portfolio into other units. Three executives—Åsa Tamsons, Chafic Nassif, and Andres Vicente—exit the Executive Team on December 31, 2026. No financial terms, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock are applicable; watch for execution risk around the restructuring.
